name: ars-platform
description: ARS Platform - core de seguros modernizado, con motor de impacto social. Monorepo de servicios NestJS.

scripts.start:iam: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=services/iam-service && node services/iam-service/dist/main.js
scripts.start:iam:watch: npm run build:libs && npm run start:dev --workspace=services/iam-service
scripts.verify:rules-engine: npm run build:libs && npm run verify:rules-engine --workspace=packages/shared-common
scripts.start:product-rating: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=services/product-rating-service && node services/product-rating-service/dist/main.js
scripts.start:product-rating:watch: npm run build:libs && npm run start:dev --workspace=services/product-rating-service
